items.title: Bloom Energy Stock In Focus After California Power Deal
items.summary: California Resources Corporation previously announced a memorandum of understanding with Bloom Energy to assess at least 1 gigawatt of solid oxide fuel cell projects in California that pair power generation with carbon capture and storage, targeting both grid-connected and on-site customers across the state. The focus on high concentration carbon dioxide exhaust and large scale storage options highlights how Bloom Energy is aiming to turn its fuel cell platform into a cleaner solution for...

items.title: Bloom Energy Sinks 8%, Lumentum Down 11% as AI Power Stocks Fade After Democrat Sweep
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBloom Energy fell 8% as AI stocks sold off after Democrats swept Tuesday’s elections, and Lumentum and MARA Holdings fell with it. Data center contractors fell even more, a sign investors fear fewer data centers will get built, which would hurt Bloom too.
